newsitem.title: FRANCE: PRESS DIGEST - France - Le Monde Nov 5.
newsitem.headline: PRESS DIGEST - France - Le Monde Nov 5.

text.p: These are leading stories in afternoon daily Le Monde.
-- Russian President Boris Yeltsin delegated powers to Prime Minister Victor Chernomyrdin before undergoing coronary bypass surgery in Moscow today.

-- CGIP chairman Ernest-Antoine Seilliere says in an interview that auto parts maker Valeo in which he bought a 20.3 percent stake has strong potential for growth, expects turnover to rise to 40 billion francs by year 2000 from 25 billion in 1995. CGIP intends to draw from Valeo dividends around one third of net profit, up from levels of 15 to 18 percent in the past few years.
-- Senate Finance Committee report calls for interest to be paid on retail bank accounts, adds all banking services should be subject to a fee.
-- Lagardere's Matra and British Aerospace merge missiles activity into eight-billion-franc turnover unit.
-- Government postpones National Assembly debate on project to reform SNCF state-owned railway operator by separating railroad infrastructure and operations.
